newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN C.BANK OKAYS HANSABANK-LATVIJA CAPITAL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN C.BANK OKAYS HANSABANK-LATVIJA CAPITAL BOOST.

text.p: Hansabank-Latvija, a subsidiary of leading Estonian bank Hansapank, said on Tuesday that the Latvian central bank had approved its capital boost to six million lats from 4.5 million lats.
The bank said in a statement that the increase was raised through a new share issue. The nominal value of each share is one lat.
The new shares will start receiving dividends from July 1.

"The capital boost was necessary for continued successful development of the bank's activities...in order to increase its ability to compete and attract clients both in Latvia and abroad," the statement said.
The statement added that the central bank gave its approval on June 19.
